document.title: Grow an SMS list

source.description_exact: Did we just become text friends? Get Instagram followers on your SMS list
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Grow an SMS list
Business value
Your followers like you, and they want a direct line to you. Give ‘em what they want while building a tight-knit, private SMS list so you’ve got your faves on another channel.
How does it work?

We’ll help you collect and store phone numbers from your Instagram audience, so you can engage folks via SMS, turning it into a "secret line" that’s only available to your VIPs — and creating multiple touchpoints to keep your favorite folks engaged.

Back To List
Set Up Template

graph_integrity.limitation: Original graph is not exposed. Draft edges use visible navigation identity; no hidden IDs or server export.

selection.choose_when: Use VIP keywords to collect a phone, followed by confirmation and a 23-hour reminder on no response.
selection.avoid_when: The reminder has no second phone collection. No SMS send is in this graph.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
